baselines.reason: One-time squash of the five drizzle-kit 0.x migrations (0000-0004) into one drizzle-kit 1.0 baseline carrying the runtime roles, constraints, indexes and reference data before first ship (ISSUE-6); inert once the baseline lands on the default branch.

One-time squash of the eight migrations carrying the two-stack schema (debates, ai_debates, debate_documents and friends) into one baseline carrying the one-Round model of ADR 0058: formats with immutable revisions and presets, durable rooms, rounds with segments, utterances, ballots on the shared contract, agent runs and usage reservations, and documents owned by actors. Daisy is pre-ship with no deployed consumers (ADR 0023); no data is migrated, so every local and test database resets once. Inert once the baseline lands on the default branch.
